name: @aos/knowledge-source-manager
description: AOS Enterprise Knowledge Source Manager — manages the actual, tenant-configured Knowledge Source instances built on top of a registered Knowledge Provider definition. Knowledge Provider defines WHAT a provider is; Knowledge Source Manager manages the ACTUAL configured sources owned by tenants. Orchestrates Source registration, catalog indexing, resolution, scheduling metadata, policy, permission, lifecycle, and validation only — no OAuth, no secrets, no connector SDKs, no synchronization, no retrieval, no indexing, no embedding, no memory, no AI, no provider-specific logic.
